name: IAMGOLD Corporation
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-18, SEC EDGAR form40f.htm, CIK 1203464), cover page: securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b) are 'Common Shares, no par value', trading symbol IAG, New York Stock Exchange, with 591,144,545 shares outstanding as of period end — exactly the engine's DEI count; the NYSE security is the common share itself, not an ADS
ads_ratio.reason: IAMGOLD is a direct cross-listing, not an ADS program: one NYSE-traded IAG share is one common share (the same class trades on the TSX as IMG), so per-share figures from the 40-F are directly comparable to the traded price with no scaling.

f_subtype_basis: sum of the last 3 fiscal years (the median window)
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 6.7%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 40-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-18, SEC EDGAR form40f.htm, CIK 1203464), cover page: securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b) are 'Common Shares, no par value', trading symbol IAG, New York Stock Exchange, with 591,144,545 shares outstanding as of period end — exactly the engine's DEI count; the NYSE security is the common share itself, not an ADS) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
note: No positive NORMALIZED (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings — OE DCF not supportable on numbers alone. If the latest year alone is positive, that is a flag to investigate, not a pass.
